$comment: PHASE 12 POINT 4 — deterministic API test census, generated from the JSON reporter of the two canonical projects. It is the FIRST authoritative baseline for API test accounting: every earlier figure was hand-reported in a ledger with no preserved runner artifact and is explicitly non-authoritative (see `historicalBaselines`). Per-file COUNTS are recorded for provenance but are deliberately not pinned, because the suites listed in `fileInventoryDriven` emit one assertion per web source file and therefore move with the tree. The machine-checked invariants live in `services/api/test/phase-12-point4-test-census.test.ts`.

fileInventoryDriven.explanation: These three suites call `walkFiles(apps/web)` and generate an `it()` per discovered source file (plus per forbidden-pattern). Their case counts therefore rise and fall with the web tree — which is why raw API totals from two different tree states are NOT comparable, and why the historical 19,360 figure cannot be reconciled by arithmetic against the current tree.

historicalBaselines.reason: Recorded in docs/architecture/program-ledger.md by a prior session. No JSON report, no runner log and no census artifact was preserved, and the tree state that produced it cannot be reconstructed (it was an uncommitted working tree). It must NOT be used as an executable baseline.
Observed directly from `vitest run --reporter=basic`. Usable as a summary boundary but not for per-file arithmetic.
Generated from the JSON reporter of both projects, per file, with duplicate-discovery and twin checks. This is the first baseline that can be re-derived exactly.
